classification.difficultyReason: Requires applying the 10% increase to all three dimensions, calculating the resulting volume, and expressing its change relative to the original volume as a percentage.

content.prompt: A cube measures $5\text{ cm}$ by $5\text{ cm}$ by $5\text{ cm}$.

questionDiagrams.alt: Cube with three edges labelled 5 cm.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Work out the volume of the cube.

inlines.text: The length of all the sides is increased by 10%.
Calculate the percentage increase in the volume of the cube.

answer.worked:
Each dimension is multiplied by $1.1$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Volume multiplier}&=1.1^3\\\text{Volume multiplier}&=1.331\\\text{Percentage increase}&=(1.331-1)\times100\%\\\text{Percentage increase}&=33.1\%\end{align*}$$
